diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng` already references `:resource.aws_launch_template.ng` implicitly via `mixed_instances_policy.launch_template.launch_template_specification` (`launch_template_id`/`version`), so the explicit `depends_on` on the launch template duplicates an ordering Terraform already infers.
`:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng` already depends on `:resource.aws_iam_role.ng` implicitly via `node_role_arn = aws_iam_role.ng.0.arn`, so the explicit `depends_on` on the role is redundant.

`:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate` already depends on `:resource.aws_iam_role.fargate` implicitly via `pod_execution_role_arn = aws_iam_role.fargate.0.arn`, so the explicit `depends_on` on the role is redundant.

`:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng` uses `aws_iam_role.ng` for its nodes but does not depend on `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm-managed`. When `enable_ssm` is set, the SSM policy must be attached to the node role before instances boot so the SSM agent can register; the sibling Worker/CNI/ECR attachments are already in `depends_on`, but this one is omitted.

`:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng` does not depend on `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.extra`. Any user-supplied policies attached to the node role must be in place before the node group launches instances; the other role policy attachments are listed in `depends_on`, but `extra` is omitted.

`:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng` (self-managed nodes) launches instances assuming the `aws_iam_role.ng` role, but does not depend on `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm-managed`. When `enable_ssm` is set, the SSM policy must be attached to the role before instances launch so the SSM agent registers; the Worker/CNI/ECR attachments are already in `depends_on`, but this one is omitted.

`:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng` (self-managed nodes) does not depend on `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.extra`. Additional policies for the node role must be attached before instances boot; the other role policy attachments are listed in `depends_on`, but `extra` is omitted.
